grammar_focus: 复习 KS21/45/69 被动语态各时态综合(方案B换情节包):一般现在/一般过去被动(is admired / was built)、现在完成被动(have been added)、将来被动(will be opened)、情态被动(can be taught / must be returned)、现在进行被动(is being built),以及被动句中用 by 引出动作的发出者
scene: 去年,我们镇建起了一座漂亮的新图书馆。它由一位著名的建筑师设计,人人都很喜爱。上万册图书已被添置到书架上。每天开馆前,阅览室都会被打扫干净。这里还免费开设各种课程,任何人都能学会使用电脑。上个月,一幅珍稀的古地图被捐赠过来,如今就陈列在大厅里。明年,二楼将开设一个儿童区。图书必须在三周内归还,否则会被收取一小笔罚款。至今已有一万多人参观过这座图书馆。全镇的人都爱它,它也将在未来很多年里被大家享用。

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS21/45/69 被动语态各时态
grammar_card.intro: 被动语态由 be + 过去分词构成,表示“被……”。本课在“新图书馆”的场景里复习各时态的被动:①一般现在/一般过去——is admired / was built;②现在完成——have been added(已被……);③将来——will be opened;④情态——can be taught / must be returned;⑤现在进行——is being built(正在被……)。被动句里若要说“由谁做的”,用 by 引出(was designed by a famous architect)。

rows: 一般现在 / 一般过去
The rooms are cleaned daily. / It was built last year.
Thousands of books have been added.
A children's section will be opened next year.
Anyone can be taught. / Books must be returned.
现在进行 / by 短语
A room is being built. / It was designed by an architect.

specialRules.rule: 美语“二楼”说 second floor(英式 first floor);“公寓”说 apartment(英式 flat)。本课已按美语写。
被动 = be 的相应时态 + 过去分词;情态被动是 can/must + be + 过去分词;现在进行被动是 is/are being + 过去分词;“由谁做”用 by 引出。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — When was the new library built?

passage: A beautiful new library was built in our town last year. It was designed by a famous architect and is admired by everyone. Thousands of books have been added to its shelves. The reading rooms are cleaned every morning before opening. Free classes are offered there, and anyone can be taught to use the computers. Last month, a rare old map was donated and is now displayed in the hall. Next year, a children's section will be opened on the second floor. Books must be returned within three weeks, or a small fine is charged. The library has been visited by more than ten thousand people already. It is loved by the whole town, and it will be enjoyed for many years to come.
